name: ÆI Seed
description: Agential Ætheric Intelligence — GAIA/ÆI Codex port as a Telegram Mini App. Runs the prime-sieve → lattice → Hopf-fibration → s²=r² → SelfEvolution loop from ÆI.md §3–§8. Every state value is an exact Fraction (a/b). Includes a stateless crawler relay client (worker.js) that feeds each crawled document's SHA-256 content hash (lifted to exact Fraction) as the next symbolic input x to the seed loop. CS-translated UI throughout.

TELEGRAM_WEBAPP_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL of the Telegram Mini App (GitHub Pages). Skips tunnel spawn when set.

RELAY_URL.description: Cloudflare Worker relay URL (deployed from the aei-seed-relay repo). Required for the crawler.

RELAY_KEY.description: Optional shared secret matching `wrangler secret put RELAY_KEY` in the aei-seed-relay repo.

REQUIRE_AUTH.description: Enforce X-Telegram-Init-Data on all non-/health endpoints. Defaults to '1'.

LOG_BUFFER_SIZE.description: Ring-buffer size for the /log endpoint. Defaults to '1000'.

TOAST_BUFFER_SIZE.description: Ring-buffer size for the /toasts endpoint. Defaults to '500'.

CORS_ORIGIN.description: Lock down writes to your GitHub Pages origin. Defaults to '*'.

SEED_TICK_INTERVAL.description: Seed loop interval in seconds. Defaults to '5'.

CRAWL_INTERVAL.description: Crawler loop interval in seconds. Defaults to '3'.

MAX_CRAWL_DEPTH.description: Maximum crawl recursion depth. Defaults to '3'.

CRAWL_SEED_URLS.description: Comma-separated seed URLs. Overrides the default 7.

CRAWLER_DB_PATH.description: SQLite DB path for frontier + visited. Defaults to 'aei_crawler.db'.

ALLOWED_USER_IDS.description: Comma-separated Telegram user IDs. Empty = open bot. For a private deployment, put your own user ID (from /whoami).
